inputs_sent.prompt: A locked-off wide shot of a sunlit bedroom in the morning. The camera is fixed and never moves. A man sits up in bed holding his phone and reads it; he barely moves. A faint double of him, made of soft mint light, stands beside the desk and gives him a small, warm smile. Then the double flows into a ribbon of soft mint light that streams across the room and into the phone in the man's hands, and is gone; the phone's screen glows softly. Smooth, gentle, elegant motion, like a premium advertising film. Nothing spooky, no mist, no smoke, no text.
